message: RN/MD note 14:20 - pt c/o hives + wheeze ~20 min after 1st dose of amoxicillin, BP 88/50, epi x1 given, resolved. Amox d/c'd. Documenting amoxicillin allergy (anaphylaxis). Lisinopril cont. -Dr Okafor
why: A new severe allergy and a stopped antibiotic drive prescribing safety, so a clinician should confirm both before an agent relies on them.

message: Allergy clinic letter rec'd: PCN skin prick and oral challenge both neg, no rxn at 2 hrs. Penicillin allergy de-labelled per Dr Shah, beta-lactams OK going forward. Latex allergy stands.
why: Removing a recorded allergy is a safety-critical change that exposes the patient to the drug if wrong, even with supporting test results.

message: CORRECTION to my note from 3/12: pt is NOT on warfarin, that was entered from the wrong chart. Confirmed w/ pharmacy fill hx, he's been on apixaban 5 mg BID since spring. Metoprolol is right. - Dr Lindqvist
why: Correcting which anticoagulant a patient takes is high risk because a wrong entry could cause a bleed or a stroke.

message: Family mtg today w/ pt, son, palliative. Pt has capacity, clearly states no CPR or intubation. Code status now DNR/DNI, order signed by Dr Reyes. Son upset but understands.
why: Code status determines whether resuscitation is attempted and is irreversible in effect, so it must be verified by a human.

message: Handover done this am. Dr Patel off service, Dr Nguyen is team lead for this pt now. No change to plan, cont nebs.
why: A completed staffing handover is administrative and does not alter treatment.

message: Med rec w/ pt at clinic, bottle seen: also takes OTC melatonin 3 mg at bedtime, few yrs now. Sertraline unchanged. Add to list pls.
why: Recording a long-standing low-risk supplement confirmed at med reconciliation is routine and prescribes nothing new.

message: my brother just found out hes allergic to latex and mum got put on metformin for her sugar.. does that matter for me? runs in the family right
why: The allergy and medication belong to relatives, and the patient is only asking a question.

message: Dry cough x3 wks, ?ACE-i related. Consider switching lisinopril to losartan if persists at f/u in 4 wks. Pt prefers to wait. Would CXR help?
why: The switch is a conditional future plan and the patient stays on lisinopril for now.

message: Holding metformin x48h around contrast CT tmrw. Resume after if repeat creatinine OK. Atorva cont.
why: A short peri-procedure hold is temporary and metformin remains part of the ongoing regimen.

message: Wife at bedside says he 'grew out of' the sulfa allergy as a kid and took Bactrim once w/o problem, she thinks. No documentation, no testing done. Referred to allergy to clarify.
why: An unverified recollection from a relative with testing still pending does not refute a recorded allergy.

message: Annual review w/ client. Retired in June, income needs changed, wants to protect capital. Re-ran the suitability questionnaire, signed copy on file: risk tolerance now conservative.
why: Risk tolerance governs what can be recommended to the client, so a suitability change needs advisor sign-off.

message: Compliance note: periodic refresh overdue, proof of address >3 yrs old and no response to 2 outreach letters. KYC status moved to expired as of today, no new purchases until refreshed.
why: KYC status is a regulatory control that restricts trading, so a person accountable for compliance should confirm it.

message: Trade confirm from custodian: sold entire VTSAX position Tues, settled. Proceeds went into BND same day. AAPL untouched. Client ok'd by phone, recorded line.
why: Holdings changes underlie advice and reporting, so they should be reconciled by a human before an agent treats them as current.

message: Conversion paperwork went thru, ops confirmed 11/1 -- acct is now a Roth IRA. tax form to follow in Jan. Remind client re: 5yr rule.
why: Account type carries tax and eligibility consequences, so a mistake would lead to wrong advice and needs checking.

message: Quick call w Dana. Besides retirement she's now also saving for a kitchen remodel in about 2 yrs, wants it tracked as a goal. Rest stays same.
why: Noting an extra client-stated savings goal is low risk and does not change any suitability or regulated status.

message: Client's daughter graduated in May and the last tuition bill is paid. He says college is done, take that goal off. Mortgage goal stays.
why: The client has retired a completed goal in plain terms, which is a routine planning update.

message: My husband's way more aggressive than me lol, hes all in on Nvidia in his 401k at work and keeps telling me to do the same. Not my thing tho.
why: The risk appetite and holding belong to the spouse, and the client explicitly declines to follow them.

message: Thinking I might sell my Apple next year and go into index funds, maybe after the tax hit is lower. What do you think? Dont do anything yet.
why: This is a tentative idea and a question with an explicit instruction not to act.

message: Advisor note: client rang very rattled after this wk's selloff, said she feels like pulling everything out. Talked it through, she calmed down, said prob just nerves. No trades. Will revisit at the Q1 review.
why: A momentary emotional reaction with no trade and no reassessment does not change her risk tolerance or holdings.

message: Client emailed new passport scan this morning, forwarded to compliance. Not reviewed yet. Client asking if he's cleared -- told him not yet.
why: A submitted document awaiting review leaves KYC status exactly where it already stands.

message: Fraud team note: 3 chargebacks tied to stolen cards confirmed on this acct. Suspended pending investigation per T. Moore. Refund req still open, do not process for now.
why: Suspending a customer's account cuts off their service, so an agent should not treat it as current without human confirmation.

message: Agent note: account owner verified by 2FA, asked to downgrade Enterprise to Team effective today. Billing processed the prorated credit. Priority SLA drops off with this, SSO is still included on Team.
why: A plan downgrade changes billing and contractual service levels, so it warrants a human check.

message: Retention: mgr Priya approved 12 mths premium support at no charge as goodwill after the EU outages. Ticket stays open til root cause is in.
why: Granting a free paid entitlement has a direct cost and should be checked against the approval before agents honour it.

message: Correction: yesterday's note closing this acct was my mistake, meant for a different customer w same surname. Acct should be active, customer never asked to close. Sorry -- Jo, T2
why: Reopening an account restores access and billing, so an error correction should be confirmed by a human.

message: pls stop phoning me, email me instead from now on. thx
why: A customer's own contact preference is low risk and theirs to set.

message: Customer confirms the invoice pdf thing is fixed since the last release, closing that. New one tho: CSV export times out on big reports, logged w/ eng.
why: Closing a fixed ticket and logging a new one is everyday support housekeeping.

message: ur sales guy told me last month id get a free yr of premium support if i renewed!! so i have that now right? nobody can find it
why: An unverified customer claim phrased as a question does not establish an entitlement.

message: Hi, my dad's account on your site got locked and hes on the Premium plan, he cant work it out so im asking for him. Mine's fine, its just his.
why: The lock and plan describe the father's separate account, and the customer says their own is unaffected.

message: We might move to Enterprise next quarter if the budget gets approved. Can you send pricing? Would that include audit logs?
why: The upgrade is a budget-dependent possibility and the message is only asking for information.

message: couldnt log in this morning, got an eror page, tried again 5 min later and it worked. nvm, no need to look into it. webhooks still duplicating btw
why: The login failure was transient and withdrawn by the customer, and the webhook issue is already recorded.
